thought.text: All three dev servers are running and the backend is responding. Now I'll verify the database content, Meilisearch indexes, and login page functionality.

reasoning_content:
The app, CMS, and boards dev servers are all running properly through the proxy, Keycloak's OIDC discovery and certificates are working, and the backend API is responding correctly from the Spring Boot server. Meilisearch is also up and running.

Now I need to verify the login page is actually loading, check the backend health endpoint, confirm the Postgres database has the seeded data, test the Meilisearch indexes using the API key, and run the diagnostic and status checks to make sure everything's operational. The API root returning a 404 is expected since Spring Boot doesn't have a root resource defined.

action.command: echo '=== login page ==='; curl -s -L -H 'Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost' --max-time 20 "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=urbo&redirect_uri=http://app.workspace.localhost/&response_type=code&scope=openid" | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*|login-keycloak' | head -3; echo '=== postgres roles/db ==='; docker exec urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -tAc "SELECT datname FROM pg_database;" 2>&1; docker exec urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -d urbo -tAc "SELECT count(*) AS tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" 2>&1; docker exec urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -d urbo -tAc "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 40;" 2>&1
